rubric.role_summary: New graduate software engineer building games and game-engine features for a London-based multiplayer gaming platform.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
New graduate software engineer building games and game-engine features for a London-based multiplayer gaming platform.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 2026 or 2027 new graduate.
- Degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related subject, OR equivalent practical experience.
- Some professional software engineering experience through internships OR scaled side projects.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience developing games, game engines, or mods through side projects.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater London, United Kingdom area. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.

source_quotes: We’re a profitable video game start-up in London with 15 million monthly players and we’re hiring New Grad Software Engineers (2026 or 2027)  to join our 11-person founding team.
A permanent desk in our King’s Cross office

soft_requirements: Passion for gaming and interest in building games for large player communities.
Strong engineering fundamentals and product sense; willingness to work across game design, UI/UX, and community management and learn from player feedback.
Interest in difficult engineering problems and voxel, sandbox, and multiplayer games.
Willingness to learn TypeScript, React, WebGL, and Node if not already familiar with them.
